name: Blank
description: A fresh presentation (gslides-parity SPEC 6.1): one Title slide with empty placeholders, titled Untitled presentation, and the theme starter set of four two-tone pictures from the GT brand deck (two opener materials, one mood photograph, one closing picture, with their credits) so Section header, Caption and Closing work on a new deck. deck.create copies deck.json, slides/ and assets/ into decks/<id> with a new id, title and revision 0; the archetypes are the layout list of packages/schema/src/layouts.ts. The `brand` fields are the deployment's default kit when no default template names another (docs/PRODUCT.md 4.1, 4.3): the name every Reset and every default logo reads, and the appearance a new presentation opens in.
